variant_note: T-72B3 obr. 2011 (T-72B rebuilt with Sosna-U gunner's sight and Kontakt-5 ERA). Not the T-72B3 obr. 2016 / 'T-72B3M', which adds Relikt ERA side skirts with slat screens, a V-92S2F engine and a commander's panoramic sight.

armament.main: 125 mm 2A46M-5 smoothbore gun with autoloader (22 rounds in the carousel)
armament.secondary: 7.62 mm PKTM coaxial machine gun, 12.7 mm NSVT anti-aircraft machine gun

protection: Combined multilayer armour with Kontakt-5 explosive reactive armour on the turret and hull front; 80 mm hull sides behind rubber-fabric side screens
silhouette_features: Low rounded cast turret covered with sharp wedge-shaped Kontakt-5 ERA blocks on both sides of the long 125 mm gun
Boxy Sosna-U gunner's sight housing that clearly sticks out of the turret roof
Wind sensor mast on the turret roof
Low hull with rubber side skirts over the upper run of the tracks
details: Six large rubber-tyred road wheels and three return rollers per side, rear drive sprocket, front idler
